body.text: Continue the backward carry phase through 32 minutes. At the midpoint full-start lifts recover to 47/64, clearing the stop condition. Seven of 16 original carry starts reach the intermediate carry event and zero achieve a complete suffix. The prior 15/16 support-release ability persists. Correlated exploration ends with 39 lifts and nine early joint excursions. The 18-minute correlated actor was safer, and neither has a complete turn. The incumbent stays eligible for the gate and delivery.

The paired GPU policy comparison passes the supplied 128-start outcome check and the extra r0184 diagnostics. CPU and Warp each lift 107 of 128 with four discordant starts, both have 128 rests, and neither has a success, hardware violation, stop or contract error. CPU drops 106 lifted plugs and GPU drops 107 under the recorded terminal support definition. GPU closed-loop collection takes 42.65 s for all 76,800 calls. The subsequent scalar monitor and scoring bring total elapsed time to 413.92 s. This probe applies the installed monitor retrospectively. A training implementation still needs in-loop monitor termination, staged reset consistency and complete-carry dynamic checks. Artifacts are paired128_comparison.json and paired128_standard.json under research/simulation/warp_plant_probe.

Test the preflighted reconstructed thumb-contact reward as an independent PPO change. Use the same r0128 parent, 24 stations, v6, seed 3298744, std 0.12, actor KL bound 0.040, reset mix and contract action bounds as r0145. Add only the 1.8-weight signed thumb proximity potential from r0148 and r0149. It uses the r0007 housing contact patch, its 180-degree symmetry, a 5 mm tolerance and credited directional rotation under clear opposition. A lifted drop refunds the temporary reward. In replay, three static controls score zero, random controls score below zero and three full witnesses keep returns from 57.48 to 57.85. Two capped exact turns get 0.61–0.62 transient guide credit. Allocate 30 minutes and measure 64 fixed starts near 8, 18 and 30. At 18 stop for fewer than 32 lifts without new safe exact turns or stronger held geometry. Predict closer demonstrated thumb roll and more retained relative turn while pickup stays viable. The actor receives no contact state or target actions.

The 128-start GPU parity pass covers the incumbent pickup and drop distribution. Three independently selected complete CPU feasibility traces were also replayed as identical palm and hand demands through the GPU ramp and controller. Across four GPU copies per trace there are 12 lifts, six qualifying finger turns, five carries and zero qualifying placements. Seven finish upright near or in the goal, all 12 rest and complete all 600 calls, and all are clear of hardware, stop and contract events. Small contact differences change whether the final set-down stays held through tabletop support. Keep the CPU training and gate configuration while testing the same witness commands under microscopic x, y and yaw perturbations on CPU. Reports are feasible_replay_*.json in research/simulation/warp_plant_probe. No GPU slot has trained the policy.

Test the missing supported descent with the same r0177 actor, restored critic and Adam, v6 PPO and mix as r0178, changing only the stage-3 reset distribution. The new pool has 86 physically checked pre-touchdown configurations across ten complete CPU witnesses with prior held carry and 12–30 mm clearance. Both prior actors complete zero of 16 fixed lowering suffixes and lose hold around 0.04 s, while neutral targets preserve median 0.40 s on a separate 32-state hold stress. Of three exact CPU witnesses replayed with only the final descent projected through the deployed r0128 transform, seed 32012322 still passes all four stages and safety. Train 24 CPU stations for up to 28 minutes, check exact fixed deployment 64 and 16 each lowering and supported-release at around 8, 17 and 28 minutes. Continue backward curriculum at 8 safe lowering placements, 12 safe release suffixes and 32 deployment lifts. Stop at 17 minutes if zero safe lowering placements and no full-turn or actual held touchdown improvement. No feasibility commands enter PPO.

body.hypothesis: Soft guidance toward the reconstructed thumb patch should advance opposed finger rotation once off support.
body.reflection: At the eight-minute check, 51/64 lift and 46 rest, with five loaded joint excursions and zero exact turns, stops or contract errors. Twenty-two lifts satisfy both standard 45-degree magnitudes. The nearest eligible tilt is 31.49 deg with 41.91 deg relative rotation, and median clear opposition is 1.57 s. This physical near-turn falls short of several criterion thresholds. Continue to the predeclared midpoint.

reward_terms.name: enclosure
reward_terms.formula: Signed change in two-sided fingertip-to-housing error, with a ramp settling deadband. Loss of proximity beyond the initial gap carries a negative slope.

reward_terms.name: lift_progress
reward_terms.formula: Signed change in opposed clearance through the lift, turn and carry. The potential is zero without an unsupported opposed grip.

reward_terms.name: lift
reward_terms.formula: One bonus for 0.13 s of downward-palm opposed clearance at 10 mm and body rise at 15 mm.

reward_terms.name: turn_progress
reward_terms.formula: Signed progress on the geometric mean of blade tilt toward world up and blade rotation relative to the wrist while opposed in air. Unqualified progress reverses on contact loss.

reward_terms.name: passive_turn
reward_terms.formula: Relative angular travel in 0.10 s windows with finger speed below 0.30 rad/s, as a fraction of 20 degrees.

reward_terms.name: finger_turn
reward_terms.formula: One bonus for 45 degrees of relative opposed turning from 55 to 25 degrees world tilt, with wrist travel at most 50 degrees and passive travel at most 20 degrees.

reward_terms.name: carry_progress
reward_terms.formula: Signed shrinkage of horizontal goal error during the uninterrupted unsupported hold, including partial credit during the turn at tilt below 50 degrees.

reward_terms.name: carry
reward_terms.formula: One bonus for 0.10 s of clear held carry within the goal at tilt at most 35 degrees, after an opposed turn.

reward_terms.name: setdown_progress
reward_terms.formula: Signed shrinkage of height and tilt error after the clear carry, while the grip still controls the object.

reward_terms.name: touchdown
reward_terms.formula: One bonus for tabletop support reached in the same held carry before release, upright enough to stand.

reward_terms.name: release
reward_terms.formula: One bonus for half a second of released, stable placement and hand rest after the supported touchdown.

reward_terms.name: placed
reward_terms.formula: Terminal bonus for the continuous ordered skill, throughout the last half second inside the exact stability and rest bounds.

reward_terms.name: reference_object
reward_terms.formula: Signed progress of symmetric reconstructed object keypoint error with 40 mm deadband, weighted at full strength while held or released in the goal.

reward_terms.name: reference_wrist
reward_terms.formula: Signed improvement in reachable reconstructed wrist position and orientation, with 100 mm and 45 degree deadbands.

reward_terms.name: reference_fingers
reward_terms.formula: Signed improvement in the median retargeted absolute posture error beyond 0.44 rad.

reward_terms.name: slip
reward_terms.formula: One loss penalty for a clear non-supported grip that loses contact before reaching the supported set-down.

reward_terms.name: action_rate
reward_terms.formula: Squared normalized changes of palm and finger targets, multiplied by five after a supported stable release.

reward_terms.name: failure
reward_terms.formula: Stop, hardware or observation-contract failure, nonfinite state or an object dropped beyond the table.

reward_terms.name: enclosed
reward_terms.formula: One bonus for at least 0.10 s of grounded thumb and opposing-digit contact at 60 degrees or more within 10 mm of pickup.

reward_terms.name: push
reward_terms.formula: Positive outward planar displacement over 3 mm before pickup plus a small absolute sliding penalty beyond that radius. No refund on return.

reward_terms.name: safety
reward_terms.formula: Squared normalized torque margin beyond 12 N·m and near-limit finger margin. Only penalties from physical state.

reward_terms.name: grounded_tilt
reward_terms.formula: Increasing departure from the initial blade tilt beyond 15 degrees while the plug is still supported before a qualifying lift.

reward_terms.name: release_progress
reward_terms.formula: Signed change in untouched support after a valid touchdown, with the upright object inside the goal and below both motion limits.

reward_terms.name: rest_progress
reward_terms.formula: Signed change in a half-second placed-and-released rest potential, based on measured palm and encoder ranges.

reward_terms.name: thumb_turn_contact
reward_terms.formula: Signed change in the best thumb proximity improvement during the current opposed interval, scaled by credited directional turn progress. A 5 mm tolerance and 180-degree housing symmetry apply. Unqualified progress is lost on contact loss.

body.text: The contact-guided actor r0201 makes a safe 31.49-degree endpoint after a continuous thumb–middle grasp. Its closest local window has 38.65 degrees of relative blade turn, 15.05 wrist, all rows palm-down and zero passive rotation. It still drops at that endpoint. r0200 preserves 55/64 lifts and lengthens the median hold to 2.99 s. Before changing training, compare paired stochastic probes of r0200 with zero-mean episode-persistent differential curl and spread in the thumb–middle pair, activated in the training environment only after established airborne opposition. This leaves the approach, deployment network and original step noise unchanged. Test added raw scales 0, 0.28 and 0.48 on 48 full prefixes and 32 fixed assisted turns. Choose a scale only if the added exploration yields a new safe exact full turn or a clear gain in assisted turns without higher safety failures. No controller actions or rewards are added.

More than 90 percent of update blocks pass pickup screening, so it meets the predeclared continuation rule. Compare completion while keeping the first checkpoint as the stronger turning parent.

body.text: Keep pickup-screen training toward the planned 40-minute endpoint because more than 90% of update blocks pass and both evaluated actors are safe. The 18-minute actor only protects pickup count. It loses 1.93 s of median paired opposition on 43 common lift starts and offers no turn gain, so use the 8-minute actor for new experiments. The additional differential thumb–middle noise study did not meet its allocation threshold. All scales have 25/48 lifts, zero exact full turns and four failures. Assisted turn bonuses are 0/32, 0/32 and 1/32 at scales 0, 0.28 and 0.48, with median clear hold falling from 0.805 to 0.745 s. No PPO change for this test. The fixed middle target floors at 0 and +0.04 reduce one fresh startup problem, but 13 and 12 of 20 selected risk prefixes still fail. Retain those as physical failure evidence only.

body.text: Continue the thumb-contact branch to the planned 30-minute endpoint. The midpoint gives 46/64 lifts and no deterministic turn, with five loaded startup limit events. It exceeds the 32-lift stop cutoff. Review shows the two closest learned approaches lose thumb and middle contact together or within 20 ms. Pose estimates are valid at those events. The new contact-aware value model will test whether richer training-only state improves PPO credit for that fragile transition.

Distinguish early accumulated divergence from local GPU set-down dynamics. Replay three complete archived CPU witnesses to their verified pre-touchdown command and transfer the live qpos, qvel, solver warm start and delayed arm and hand state to four GPU copies per witness. body.text: Test whether reducing the load of full gravity makes the handoff from lift to in-hand turn explorable. On the same 32 held-turn resets, compare the r0200 actor at 1.00, 0.75 and 0.50 of object gravity with unchanged robot dynamics and paired sensor and Gaussian draws. Apply only an upward compensating force at the object COM, so net gravity remains downward and supplies no goal direction or moment. Do not put this in PPO unless it improves assisted turn bonuses and maintains safety with a clear advantage over the nominal probe. Any following training would keep full gravity on deployment starts and anneal the assistance away before evaluation. The gravity curriculum motivation is from Ojaghi et al., https://arxiv.org/abs/2407.09986.

Test a more informative PPO value baseline through the fragile opposed turn. From the safe r0200 actor, compare two 24-minute v6 CPU branches with 12 stations each, fresh critics and optimizers, seed 920627, the existing reset mix and signed reward, raw std 0.12, KL 0.040 and the same eight-update pickup screen relative to that actor. Only one critic gains 66 inputs: exact palm-relative geometry and joint velocities, per-digit contact centers and loads, opposition, anchor, reference and interval state. The actor input and architecture remain identical in both branches. The four-update implementation smoke exports a v3 actor with 0.595 ms action p99. Compare 64 fixed episodes at about 8, 17 and 24 minutes and record explained variance on the held reset modes. Continue after 17 minutes only if the expanded critic has at least 32 safe lifts or makes a safe full turn or at least 10 degrees of held tilt improvement at 45 degrees relative over the control. The approach uses a privileged critic in the spirit of SimToolReal. https://arxiv.org/abs/2602.16863

The held-turn gravity probe returns zero, one and three turn bonuses in 32 paired starts at nominal, 75% and 50% object weight. Each is free of reported hardware and contract problems. Median opposition duration is about 0.8 s for all three, and median peak turn reward falls as assistance increases. Check an independently sampled 96-state sheet at full and half weight before spending a training slot. Proceed to a short curriculum only if the assisted bonus rate improves by at least 8 of 96 without more hardware failures.

Make turn experience more frequent without changing the deterministic actor. The safe r0200 package lifts 55/64 deterministically, while its ordinary stochastic probes lift 25/48 and have four physical failures. Compare the same 48 full-start prefixes with both episode bias and step noise multiplied by 1.0, 0.67 and 0.33 until the first qualifying lift in the reward state. Restore ordinary exploration immediately afterward. Spend a training slot only if a lower-noise pickup yields at least 12 extra safe lifts with no additional hardware failures. Conditional Gaussian likelihood and KL would keep their exact sample-specific scales. This test collects no action labels or deployment-only rules.

In the independent gravity retest, half object weight advances turn 11/96 versus 9/96 at nominal, both safe, below the eight-episode threshold. Do not add gravity assistance to training. A separate turn reset filter keeps 19 of 190 qualifying-window snapshots from three trials after a four-call hold, all beginning at 64.56–71.97 degrees tilt. Use this as evidence of cold reset fragility before choosing another turn curriculum. The live CPU-to-Warp transfer begins with bit-identical CPU source qpos for each witness. Warp completes supported in-goal placement on 8 of 12 copies, versus 0/12 from full ramp in r0197. Nine of 12 finish stably upright and all 12 rest without stops or plant limits. All four transfers on seed 6613423 lose continuous contact before support. Early accumulated divergence explains some, while local support and release disagreement remains. Keep exact CPU for PPO pending broader parity and online contract monitoring.

r0200 produces 118/128 lifts on r0119’s independent deployment slate versus 107/128 from r0128, with 14 candidate-only and three incumbent-only lifts. Both have zero turns, hardware violations, stops and contract failures, and 128/128 rests. The original fixed slate ties at 55 lifts and 64 rests. Test a fresh independent 512-start early safety prefix, then compare r0200 with the incumbent in a task gate predicting lift if the safety prefix is clean. This is an early-stage improvement hypothesis and retains the declared in-hand turn goal.

Do not gate r0200 without a startup correction. Its 512 independent prefixes show two lower middle MCP2 excursions at 0.38 and 0.39 s while thumb and middle press the housing. Peak integration overruns are 0.02300 and 0.02067 rad while the requested middle target is −0.05022. No stops or contract issues. Test single changes on those same two starts with eight independent sensing draws and 24 fresh starts. Candidates are 1 or 2 mm more ramp palm height, or 0.02 or 0.04 rad higher initial middle MCP2, with unchanged actor and action bounds. If a variant preserves pickup and removes risk events, run a complete fixed and 128-start check before any gate.

The reduced pickup-noise probe meets its allocation criterion. At factors 1, 0.67 and 0.33 it gives 25, 34 and 39 lifts in 48 paired seven-second deployment rollouts, with four, three and zero physical failures. Median clear opposition is 0.15, 0.685 and 1.355 s across all probes, with zero full turns. Start 24 minutes of PPO from r0200 with 12 stations and the settings of the r0210 control, including seed 920627, the same reward, curriculum, KL 0.040 and eight-update pickup screen. Only deployment exploration until the first qualifying lift is reduced to factor 0.33. The four-update smoke meets the analytic conditioned KL bound. Compare fixed64 at about 8, 17 and 24 minutes. Continue past 17 only with at least 32 safe lifts, a safe exact full turn or at least a 10-degree safe held tilt gain at 45 degrees relative versus that matched control. Full observation and action interfaces are unchanged.

The signed turn potential currently treats all relative blade directions alike. Some checkpoints rotate the blade strongly relative to the wrist while remaining far from upright. Compare a training-only potential that also requires finger progress toward vertical expressed in the fixed pre-turn palm frame. Wrist motion alone contributes no progress in that frame. Keep the exact bonus, criteria and other reward terms. Check still, random, complete CPU witnesses, bounded-authority turns and recent lifted failures before allocating PPO. The replacement should preserve complete return ordering and the qualified turn bonuses while suppressing misdirected intermediate rotation.

The directed reward preflight preserves every bonus on three complete CPU witnesses and totals 57.437–57.826 versus 57.437–57.826 before. Three still rollouts remain exactly zero, three random traces remain negative, and the existing bounded-prefix bonus is preserved. The misdirected high-angle r0203 trace drops in peak turn credit from 1.431 to 0.231, and the r0201 near finish still earns 2.104 during its opposed turn. Continue r0200 for a 24-minute directed-turn reward experiment, matched to the r0210 control with 12 exact CPU stations, seed 920627, std 0.12, KL 0.040, existing reset mix and eight-update lift screen. Only the signed turn potential changes. Check fixed64 at 8, 17 and 24 minutes. Stop at 17 if fewer than 32 safe lifts and neither a safe full turn nor 10 degrees of held tilt improvement at 45 degrees relative versus the control.

body.simulation: Full assembled 2 ms CPU MuJoCo with continuous arm impedance, sampled 100 Hz state, bit-exact visibility kernel and CUDA optimizer. Training uses the compiled station DLS IK. body.actor_observations: Only v3 keys. Eight fixed history taps at 0, 1, 2, 5, 10, 20, 40 and 63 calls ago. No clock or private state. Causal latest-target minus measured position and hand-encoder errors provide contact-related observability.
body.critic_observations: Actor history and training-only physical phase, true object center and blade, palm/object offset, velocities, contact and support, and mechanics draws.
body.algorithm: PPO from scratch with diagonal Gaussian exploration, episode-persistent independent Gaussian bias of 0.12 raw units, clipped likelihood and value, normalized GAE and KL guard 0.055. Advantages are normalized separately by reset mode if group_advantage is set. This segment resumes the single random-initialized PPO actor from the recorded parent checkpoint. This segment initializes the critic and optimizer afresh. The applied actor change is backtracked in parameter space until the analytic Gaussian KL from the rollout policy meets the configured bound. The optimizer moments and critic updates are retained. Each block of PPO updates is tested on paired deterministic physics prefixes against the initial actor. A candidate may lose at most the configured number of lifts and must match or improve the count of safe trials. Rejection restores actor, critic and Adam and reduces the learning rate. These episodes only constrain update acceptance.
body.actions: The actor commands 26 dimensions using bounded offsets from the measured palm and joint positions. The fixed work-volume and 0.68 rad wrist posture bound precede causal smoothing. Target deltas are bounded by 9 mm, 0.022 rad rotation and 0.066 rad per finger per call. Finger offset radius is 0.45 rad with a 0.037 rad target margin. This run uses the bounded action transform frozen in the selected startup-safety package. Its precise source path is in the hyperparameters.
body.hypothesis: Paired deterministic pickup screens should protect established contact acquisition during further PPO.
body.reflection: At 40 minutes this checkpoint has 61/64 qualifying lifts and 62 rests. Zero later stages, hardware violations, stops or contract problems in the fixed slate. Median clear opposition is 3.08 s. The best endpoint tilt is 60.84 deg, so improvement concerns pickup only. A whole-episode independent 128 and 512 monitored startup prefixes are running before a fresh lift gate decision.

reward_terms.name: enclosure
reward_terms.formula: Signed change in two-sided fingertip-to-housing error, with a ramp settling deadband. Loss of proximity beyond the initial gap carries a negative slope.

reward_terms.name: lift_progress
reward_terms.formula: Signed change in opposed clearance through the lift, turn and carry. The potential is zero without an unsupported opposed grip.

reward_terms.name: lift
reward_terms.formula: One bonus for 0.13 s of downward-palm opposed clearance at 10 mm and body rise at 15 mm.

reward_terms.name: turn_progress
reward_terms.formula: Signed progress on the geometric mean of blade tilt toward world up and blade rotation relative to the wrist while opposed in air. Unqualified progress reverses on contact loss.

reward_terms.name: passive_turn
reward_terms.formula: Relative angular travel in 0.10 s windows with finger speed below 0.30 rad/s, as a fraction of 20 degrees.

reward_terms.name: finger_turn
reward_terms.formula: One bonus for 45 degrees of relative opposed turning from 55 to 25 degrees world tilt, with wrist travel at most 50 degrees and passive travel at most 20 degrees.

reward_terms.name: carry_progress
reward_terms.formula: Signed shrinkage of horizontal goal error during the uninterrupted unsupported hold, including partial credit during the turn at tilt below 50 degrees.

reward_terms.name: carry
reward_terms.formula: One bonus for 0.10 s of clear held carry within the goal at tilt at most 35 degrees, after an opposed turn.

reward_terms.name: setdown_progress
reward_terms.formula: Signed shrinkage of height and tilt error after the clear carry, while the grip still controls the object.

reward_terms.name: touchdown
reward_terms.formula: One bonus for tabletop support reached in the same held carry before release, upright enough to stand.

reward_terms.name: release
reward_terms.formula: One bonus for half a second of released, stable placement and hand rest after the supported touchdown.

reward_terms.name: placed
reward_terms.formula: Terminal bonus for the continuous ordered skill, throughout the last half second inside the exact stability and rest bounds.

reward_terms.name: reference_object
reward_terms.formula: Signed progress of symmetric reconstructed object keypoint error with 40 mm deadband, weighted at full strength while held or released in the goal.

reward_terms.name: reference_wrist
reward_terms.formula: Signed improvement in reachable reconstructed wrist position and orientation, with 100 mm and 45 degree deadbands.

reward_terms.name: reference_fingers
reward_terms.formula: Signed improvement in the median retargeted absolute posture error beyond 0.44 rad.

reward_terms.name: slip
reward_terms.formula: One loss penalty for a clear non-supported grip that loses contact before reaching the supported set-down.

reward_terms.name: action_rate
reward_terms.formula: Squared normalized changes of palm and finger targets, multiplied by five after a supported stable release.

reward_terms.name: failure
reward_terms.formula: Stop, hardware or observation-contract failure, nonfinite state or an object dropped beyond the table.

reward_terms.name: enclosed
reward_terms.formula: One bonus for at least 0.10 s of grounded thumb and opposing-digit contact at 60 degrees or more within 10 mm of pickup.

reward_terms.name: push
reward_terms.formula: Positive outward planar displacement over 3 mm before pickup plus a small absolute sliding penalty beyond that radius. No refund on return.

reward_terms.name: safety
reward_terms.formula: Squared normalized torque margin beyond 12 N·m and near-limit finger margin. Only penalties from physical state.

reward_terms.name: grounded_tilt
reward_terms.formula: Increasing departure from the initial blade tilt beyond 15 degrees while the plug is still supported before a qualifying lift.

reward_terms.name: release_progress
reward_terms.formula: Signed change in untouched support after a valid touchdown, with the upright object inside the goal and below both motion limits.

reward_terms.name: rest_progress
reward_terms.formula: Signed change in a half-second placed-and-released rest potential, based on measured palm and encoder ranges.

domain_randomization.name: plug center x/y
domain_randomization.distribution: independent uniform ±10 mm about (0.48, −0.36) m

domain_randomization.name: plug blade yaw
domain_randomization.distribution: uniform −100 to −80 degrees, +X up

domain_randomization.name: support table extent
domain_randomization.distribution: near edge uniform 0.10 to 0.19 m, far edge uniform 0.99 to 1.00 m, half-width uniform 0.69 to 0.80 m

domain_randomization.name: plug mass and inertia scale
domain_randomization.distribution: uniform 0.85 to 1.15 times the 59 g baseline and corresponding inertia

domain_randomization.name: object/table sliding friction
domain_randomization.distribution: one shared uniform draw 0.27 to 0.47

domain_randomization.name: hand sliding friction
domain_randomization.distribution: uniform 0.64 to 1.13

domain_randomization.name: finger grip
domain_randomization.distribution: uniform 0.25 to 1.00 times deployed torque caps

domain_randomization.name: per-joint arm delay offset
domain_randomization.distribution: independent uniform −10 to +10 ms about published joint delays

domain_randomization.name: finger delay
domain_randomization.distribution: uniform 17 to 40 ms, fixed 2 Hz low-pass

domain_randomization.name: proprioception
domain_randomization.distribution: sampled 100 Hz state at lognormal acquisition age, median 13.9 ms, values from the frozen v4 evaluator

domain_randomization.name: object pose sensing
domain_randomization.distribution: supplied default d2s_sensor.PoseSensor with occlusion measured by ray-capsule visibility and independently seeded delay, noise, two-sided orientation flips and dropout

domain_randomization.name: physical reset perturbations
domain_randomization.distribution: prechecked intermediate qpos and qvel with up to ±8 mm xy and ±0.12 rad yaw on world rigid transforms, perturbed mechanics

body.text: The r0221 endpoint is a stronger pickup candidate. It lifts 124/128 versus 107/128 for r0128 on matched starts, with 19 candidate-only and two incumbent-only, zero hardware and stop events, and 127/128 rests. All 512 nominal-sensor startup prefixes pass, largest overrun 0.01981 rad. Synthetic v3 timing is 0.593 ms p99. It still has two hardware excursions across 16 alternative sensor draws on the two r0200 risky physical starts. The attempted r0200 pose variants leave at least four of 16 targeted events. Check r0221 with single fixed changes of +1, +2 or +4 mm start height, or a 0.36 or 0.30 finger target blend before deciding on a gate. Require zero targeted and fresh prefix events plus at least 20/24 fresh lifts before rerunning the full score and safety preflight.

Advance the unchanged r0221 network with a +4 mm ramp height to full preflight. The +2 and +4 mm variants both remove all 16 targeted failures and stay safe on 24 fresh prefixes. At +4 mm all 40 lift, and worst targeted overrun is 0.01531 rad versus 0.01845 at +2. Both fixed finger blends leave two targeted failures. Recheck +4 mm on all fixed64 full episodes, the prior paired 128 whole episodes and a newly sampled 512-start safety prefix. Record it as a start-pose variant of r0221 before any task gate.

A held-out episode diagnostic measures how much deployable encoder history predicts loss within 0.10 s on two paired exact simulation slates. Linear ridge scores from current finger positions and the initial five prior-target residual taps already give AUC around 0.92–0.97 across splits. Appending a causal residual using the published 2 Hz low-pass and a one-call delay increases median AUC by 0.01595 on r0128 and 0.00643 on r0221. That modest gain does not warrant a separate actor branch now. The diagnostic uses simulation labels only for measurement and no predictor weights enter PPO. The 16-start live compiled-monitor check also preserves all flags and arrays but measures 1.002× CPU speed, so the published monitor remains in training.

body.simulation: Full assembled 2 ms CPU MuJoCo with continuous arm impedance, sampled 100 Hz state, bit-exact visibility kernel and CUDA optimizer. Training uses the compiled station DLS IK. Open-loop compensation tests match all criteria for three complete witnesses and 64 learned traces. Task evaluation uses the frozen NumPy implementation.
body.actor_observations: Only v3 keys. Eight fixed history taps at 0, 1, 2, 5, 10, 20, 40 and 63 calls ago. No clock or private state. Causal latest-target minus measured position and hand-encoder errors provide contact-related observability.
body.critic_observations: Actor history and training-only physical phase, true object center and blade, palm/object offset, velocities, contact and support, and mechanics draws. Appends exact palm-relative object pose, joint velocities, opposition angle, contact centroids and normal loads per digit, and the reward trajectory anchor, continuous interval timers and reference progress.
body.algorithm: PPO from scratch with diagonal Gaussian exploration, episode-persistent independent Gaussian bias of 0.12 raw units, clipped likelihood and value, normalized GAE and KL guard 0.055. Advantages are normalized separately by reset mode if group_advantage is set. This segment resumes the single random-initialized PPO actor from the recorded parent checkpoint. This segment initializes the critic and optimizer afresh. The applied actor change is backtracked in parameter space until the analytic Gaussian KL from the rollout policy meets the configured bound. The optimizer moments and critic updates are retained. Each block of PPO updates is tested on paired deterministic physics prefixes against the initial actor. A candidate may lose at most the configured number of lifts and must match or improve the count of safe trials. Rejection restores actor, critic and Adam and reduces the learning rate. These episodes only constrain update acceptance.
body.actions: The actor commands 26 dimensions using bounded offsets from the measured palm and joint positions. The fixed work-volume and 0.68 rad wrist posture bound precede causal smoothing. Target deltas are bounded by 9 mm, 0.022 rad rotation and 0.066 rad per finger per call. Finger offset radius is 0.45 rad with a 0.037 rad target margin. This run uses the bounded action transform frozen in the selected startup-safety package. Its precise source path is in the hyperparameters.
body.hypothesis: Use extra privileged contact dynamics and reward state in the critic to improve credit for in-hand turns.
body.reflection: At 17 minutes, 54/64 fixed starts lift and 60 rest. There are two loaded middle MCP2 events, no stops or contract issues, and no exact turn. Opposition median is 2.605 s. Closest eligible tilt is 39.25 deg with up to 42.14 deg relative motion. Recent median explained variance on in-hand resets is 0.8336 versus 0.7150 for control. Meets the predeclared lift requirement to continue.

reward_terms.name: enclosure
reward_terms.formula: Signed change in two-sided fingertip-to-housing error, with a ramp settling deadband. Loss of proximity beyond the initial gap carries a negative slope.

reward_terms.name: lift_progress
reward_terms.formula: Signed change in opposed clearance through the lift, turn and carry. The potential is zero without an unsupported opposed grip.

reward_terms.name: lift
reward_terms.formula: One bonus for 0.13 s of downward-palm opposed clearance at 10 mm and body rise at 15 mm.

reward_terms.name: turn_progress
reward_terms.formula: Signed progress on the geometric mean of blade tilt toward world up and blade rotation relative to the wrist while opposed in air. Unqualified progress reverses on contact loss.

reward_terms.name: passive_turn
reward_terms.formula: Relative angular travel in 0.10 s windows with finger speed below 0.30 rad/s, as a fraction of 20 degrees.

reward_terms.name: finger_turn
reward_terms.formula: One bonus for 45 degrees of relative opposed turning from 55 to 25 degrees world tilt, with wrist travel at most 50 degrees and passive travel at most 20 degrees.

reward_terms.name: carry_progress
reward_terms.formula: Signed shrinkage of horizontal goal error during the uninterrupted unsupported hold, including partial credit during the turn at tilt below 50 degrees.

reward_terms.name: carry
reward_terms.formula: One bonus for 0.10 s of clear held carry within the goal at tilt at most 35 degrees, after an opposed turn.

reward_terms.name: setdown_progress
reward_terms.formula: Signed shrinkage of height and tilt error after the clear carry, while the grip still controls the object.

reward_terms.name: touchdown
reward_terms.formula: One bonus for tabletop support reached in the same held carry before release, upright enough to stand.

reward_terms.name: release
reward_terms.formula: One bonus for half a second of released, stable placement and hand rest after the supported touchdown.

reward_terms.name: placed
reward_terms.formula: Terminal bonus for the continuous ordered skill, throughout the last half second inside the exact stability and rest bounds.

reward_terms.name: reference_object
reward_terms.formula: Signed progress of symmetric reconstructed object keypoint error with 40 mm deadband, weighted at full strength while held or released in the goal.

reward_terms.name: reference_wrist
reward_terms.formula: Signed improvement in reachable reconstructed wrist position and orientation, with 100 mm and 45 degree deadbands.

reward_terms.name: reference_fingers
reward_terms.formula: Signed improvement in the median retargeted absolute posture error beyond 0.44 rad.

reward_terms.name: slip
reward_terms.formula: One loss penalty for a clear non-supported grip that loses contact before reaching the supported set-down.

reward_terms.name: action_rate
reward_terms.formula: Squared normalized changes of palm and finger targets, multiplied by five after a supported stable release.

reward_terms.name: failure
reward_terms.formula: Stop, hardware or observation-contract failure, nonfinite state or an object dropped beyond the table.

reward_terms.name: enclosed
reward_terms.formula: One bonus for at least 0.10 s of grounded thumb and opposing-digit contact at 60 degrees or more within 10 mm of pickup.

reward_terms.name: push
reward_terms.formula: Positive outward planar displacement over 3 mm before pickup plus a small absolute sliding penalty beyond that radius. No refund on return.

reward_terms.name: safety
reward_terms.formula: Squared normalized torque margin beyond 12 N·m and near-limit finger margin. Only penalties from physical state.

reward_terms.name: grounded_tilt
reward_terms.formula: Increasing departure from the initial blade tilt beyond 15 degrees while the plug is still supported before a qualifying lift.

reward_terms.name: release_progress
reward_terms.formula: Signed change in untouched support after a valid touchdown, with the upright object inside the goal and below both motion limits.

reward_terms.name: rest_progress
reward_terms.formula: Signed change in a half-second placed-and-released rest potential, based on measured palm and encoder ranges.

domain_randomization.name: plug center x/y
domain_randomization.distribution: independent uniform ±10 mm about (0.48, −0.36) m

domain_randomization.name: plug blade yaw
domain_randomization.distribution: uniform −100 to −80 degrees, +X up

domain_randomization.name: support table extent
domain_randomization.distribution: near edge uniform 0.10 to 0.19 m, far edge uniform 0.99 to 1.00 m, half-width uniform 0.69 to 0.80 m

domain_randomization.name: plug mass and inertia scale
domain_randomization.distribution: uniform 0.85 to 1.15 times the 59 g baseline and corresponding inertia

domain_randomization.name: object/table sliding friction
domain_randomization.distribution: one shared uniform draw 0.27 to 0.47

domain_randomization.name: hand sliding friction
domain_randomization.distribution: uniform 0.64 to 1.13

domain_randomization.name: finger grip
domain_randomization.distribution: uniform 0.25 to 1.00 times deployed torque caps

domain_randomization.name: per-joint arm delay offset
domain_randomization.distribution: independent uniform −10 to +10 ms about published joint delays

domain_randomization.name: finger delay
domain_randomization.distribution: uniform 17 to 40 ms, fixed 2 Hz low-pass

domain_randomization.name: proprioception
domain_randomization.distribution: sampled 100 Hz state at lognormal acquisition age, median 13.9 ms, values from the frozen v4 evaluator

domain_randomization.name: object pose sensing
domain_randomization.distribution: supplied default d2s_sensor.PoseSensor with occlusion measured by ray-capsule visibility and independently seeded delay, noise, two-sided orientation flips and dropout

domain_randomization.name: physical reset perturbations
domain_randomization.distribution: prechecked intermediate qpos and qvel with up to ±8 mm xy and ±0.12 rad yaw on world rigid transforms, perturbed mechanics

body.text: Continue the matched critic pair to the 24-minute endpoint because the expanded critic retains 54 safe fixed lifts. The richer critic improves value fit, lift retention and joint-limit counts, while the control still reaches closer safe in-hand geometry on its best case. Neither converts the near turn into a full criterion pass. r0221’s +4 mm variant remains the pickup preflight candidate. Compare +4/+6/+8 mm ramp-height variants of the riskier midpoint control in short diagnostic prefixes to see whether its closest turn survives safer startup geometry. No method or gate acceptance is inferred from this diagnostic.

body.text: r0230 passes all predeclared preflight checks. It lifts 128/128 in exact whole episodes versus 107/128 for r0128 on the same starts, with 21 candidate-only and no incumbent-only lifts, 127 rests, and zero hardware, stop or contract problems. Fixed64 gives 60 lifts and 64 rests. Fresh512 startup prefixes and all 40 targeted and fresh variant probes are safe. No exact turn qualifies, so request the fresh paired task gate for lift. The only post-training change is the +4 mm palm ramp endpoint. Package manifest SHA-256 2f39b21ce070….

body.simulation: Full assembled 2 ms CPU MuJoCo with continuous arm impedance, sampled 100 Hz state, bit-exact visibility kernel and CUDA optimizer. Training uses the compiled station DLS IK. Open-loop compensation tests match all criteria for three complete witnesses and 64 learned traces. Task evaluation uses the frozen NumPy implementation.
body.actor_observations: Only v3 keys. Eight fixed history taps at 0, 1, 2, 5, 10, 20, 40 and 63 calls ago. No clock or private state. Causal latest-target minus measured position and hand-encoder errors provide contact-related observability.
body.critic_observations: Actor history and training-only physical phase, true object center and blade, palm/object offset, velocities, contact and support, and mechanics draws.
body.algorithm: PPO from scratch with diagonal Gaussian exploration, episode-persistent independent Gaussian bias of 0.12 raw units, clipped likelihood and value, normalized GAE and KL guard 0.055. Advantages are normalized separately by reset mode if group_advantage is set. This segment resumes the single random-initialized PPO actor from the recorded parent checkpoint. This segment initializes the critic and optimizer afresh. The applied actor change is backtracked in parameter space until the analytic Gaussian KL from the rollout policy meets the configured bound. The optimizer moments and critic updates are retained. Each block of PPO updates is tested on paired deterministic physics prefixes against the initial actor. A candidate may lose at most the configured number of lifts and must match or improve the count of safe trials. Rejection restores actor, critic and Adam and reduces the learning rate. These episodes only constrain update acceptance. On deployment resets, scale Gaussian exploration and episode bias by 0.33 before the first qualifying lift. Use the actual conditional scale for PPO likelihood and KL. The exported actor is deterministic.
body.actions: The actor commands 26 dimensions using bounded offsets from the measured palm and joint positions. The fixed work-volume and 0.68 rad wrist posture bound precede causal smoothing. Target deltas are bounded by 9 mm, 0.022 rad rotation and 0.066 rad per finger per call. Finger offset radius is 0.45 rad with a 0.037 rad target margin. This run uses the bounded action transform frozen in the selected startup-safety package. Its precise source path is in the hyperparameters.
body.hypothesis: Lower stochastic approach noise while preserving ordinary exploration after the first lift, allowing PPO to see more held turns.
body.reflection: At eight minutes, 51/64 lift and 55 rest, with two hardware problems and no exact turn, stop or contract problem. A safe episode turns in opposition to 35.26 deg with 46.31 deg blade-relative motion, while the separate whole-interval standard relative rotation is only 41.4 deg. Median clear hold is 2.03 s. Continue to the fixed midpoint.

reward_terms.name: enclosure
reward_terms.formula: Signed change in two-sided fingertip-to-housing error, with a ramp settling deadband. Loss of proximity beyond the initial gap carries a negative slope.

reward_terms.name: lift_progress
reward_terms.formula: Signed change in opposed clearance through the lift, turn and carry. The potential is zero without an unsupported opposed grip.

reward_terms.name: lift
reward_terms.formula: One bonus for 0.13 s of downward-palm opposed clearance at 10 mm and body rise at 15 mm.

reward_terms.name: turn_progress
reward_terms.formula: Signed progress on the geometric mean of blade tilt toward world up and blade rotation relative to the wrist while opposed in air. Unqualified progress reverses on contact loss.

reward_terms.name: passive_turn
reward_terms.formula: Relative angular travel in 0.10 s windows with finger speed below 0.30 rad/s, as a fraction of 20 degrees.

reward_terms.name: finger_turn
reward_terms.formula: One bonus for 45 degrees of relative opposed turning from 55 to 25 degrees world tilt, with wrist travel at most 50 degrees and passive travel at most 20 degrees.

reward_terms.name: carry_progress
reward_terms.formula: Signed shrinkage of horizontal goal error during the uninterrupted unsupported hold, including partial credit during the turn at tilt below 50 degrees.

reward_terms.name: carry
reward_terms.formula: One bonus for 0.10 s of clear held carry within the goal at tilt at most 35 degrees, after an opposed turn.

reward_terms.name: setdown_progress
reward_terms.formula: Signed shrinkage of height and tilt error after the clear carry, while the grip still controls the object.

reward_terms.name: touchdown
reward_terms.formula: One bonus for tabletop support reached in the same held carry before release, upright enough to stand.

reward_terms.name: release
reward_terms.formula: One bonus for half a second of released, stable placement and hand rest after the supported touchdown.

reward_terms.name: placed
reward_terms.formula: Terminal bonus for the continuous ordered skill, throughout the last half second inside the exact stability and rest bounds.

reward_terms.name: reference_object
reward_terms.formula: Signed progress of symmetric reconstructed object keypoint error with 40 mm deadband, weighted at full strength while held or released in the goal.

reward_terms.name: reference_wrist
reward_terms.formula: Signed improvement in reachable reconstructed wrist position and orientation, with 100 mm and 45 degree deadbands.

reward_terms.name: reference_fingers
reward_terms.formula: Signed improvement in the median retargeted absolute posture error beyond 0.44 rad.

reward_terms.name: slip
reward_terms.formula: One loss penalty for a clear non-supported grip that loses contact before reaching the supported set-down.

reward_terms.name: action_rate
reward_terms.formula: Squared normalized changes of palm and finger targets, multiplied by five after a supported stable release.

reward_terms.name: failure
reward_terms.formula: Stop, hardware or observation-contract failure, nonfinite state or an object dropped beyond the table.

reward_terms.name: enclosed
reward_terms.formula: One bonus for at least 0.10 s of grounded thumb and opposing-digit contact at 60 degrees or more within 10 mm of pickup.

reward_terms.name: push
reward_terms.formula: Positive outward planar displacement over 3 mm before pickup plus a small absolute sliding penalty beyond that radius. No refund on return.

reward_terms.name: safety
reward_terms.formula: Squared normalized torque margin beyond 12 N·m and near-limit finger margin. Only penalties from physical state.

reward_terms.name: grounded_tilt
reward_terms.formula: Increasing departure from the initial blade tilt beyond 15 degrees while the plug is still supported before a qualifying lift.

reward_terms.name: release_progress
reward_terms.formula: Signed change in untouched support after a valid touchdown, with the upright object inside the goal and below both motion limits.

reward_terms.name: rest_progress
reward_terms.formula: Signed change in a half-second placed-and-released rest potential, based on measured palm and encoder ranges.

domain_randomization.name: plug center x/y
domain_randomization.distribution: independent uniform ±10 mm about (0.48, −0.36) m

domain_randomization.name: plug blade yaw
domain_randomization.distribution: uniform −100 to −80 degrees, +X up

domain_randomization.name: support table extent
domain_randomization.distribution: near edge uniform 0.10 to 0.19 m, far edge uniform 0.99 to 1.00 m, half-width uniform 0.69 to 0.80 m

domain_randomization.name: plug mass and inertia scale
domain_randomization.distribution: uniform 0.85 to 1.15 times the 59 g baseline and corresponding inertia

domain_randomization.name: object/table sliding friction
domain_randomization.distribution: one shared uniform draw 0.27 to 0.47

domain_randomization.name: hand sliding friction
domain_randomization.distribution: uniform 0.64 to 1.13

domain_randomization.name: finger grip
domain_randomization.distribution: uniform 0.25 to 1.00 times deployed torque caps

domain_randomization.name: per-joint arm delay offset
domain_randomization.distribution: independent uniform −10 to +10 ms about published joint delays

domain_randomization.name: finger delay
domain_randomization.distribution: uniform 17 to 40 ms, fixed 2 Hz low-pass

domain_randomization.name: proprioception
domain_randomization.distribution: sampled 100 Hz state at lognormal acquisition age, median 13.9 ms, values from the frozen v4 evaluator

domain_randomization.name: object pose sensing
domain_randomization.distribution: supplied default d2s_sensor.PoseSensor with occlusion measured by ray-capsule visibility and independently seeded delay, noise, two-sided orientation flips and dropout

domain_randomization.name: physical reset perturbations
domain_randomization.distribution: prechecked intermediate qpos and qvel with up to ±8 mm xy and ±0.12 rad yaw on world rigid transforms, perturbed mechanics

body.reflection: At 24 minutes, 39/64 lift and 39 rest, with 18 hardware events and zero stops, contract problems or turns. Median clear opposition is 1.46 s. Closest eligible tilt is 31.05 deg with 28.40 deg relative rotation. The control loses pickup performance and safety. End the comparison.

reward_terms.name: enclosure
reward_terms.formula: Signed change in two-sided fingertip-to-housing error, with a ramp settling deadband. Loss of proximity beyond the initial gap carries a negative slope.

reward_terms.name: lift_progress
reward_terms.formula: Signed change in opposed clearance through the lift, turn and carry. The potential is zero without an unsupported opposed grip.

reward_terms.name: lift
reward_terms.formula: One bonus for 0.13 s of downward-palm opposed clearance at 10 mm and body rise at 15 mm.

reward_terms.name: turn_progress
reward_terms.formula: Signed progress on the geometric mean of blade tilt toward world up and blade rotation relative to the wrist while opposed in air. Unqualified progress reverses on contact loss.

reward_terms.name: passive_turn
reward_terms.formula: Relative angular travel in 0.10 s windows with finger speed below 0.30 rad/s, as a fraction of 20 degrees.

reward_terms.name: finger_turn
reward_terms.formula: One bonus for 45 degrees of relative opposed turning from 55 to 25 degrees world tilt, with wrist travel at most 50 degrees and passive travel at most 20 degrees.

reward_terms.name: carry_progress
reward_terms.formula: Signed shrinkage of horizontal goal error during the uninterrupted unsupported hold, including partial credit during the turn at tilt below 50 degrees.

reward_terms.name: carry
reward_terms.formula: One bonus for 0.10 s of clear held carry within the goal at tilt at most 35 degrees, after an opposed turn.

reward_terms.name: setdown_progress
reward_terms.formula: Signed shrinkage of height and tilt error after the clear carry, while the grip still controls the object.

reward_terms.name: touchdown
reward_terms.formula: One bonus for tabletop support reached in the same held carry before release, upright enough to stand.

reward_terms.name: release
reward_terms.formula: One bonus for half a second of released, stable placement and hand rest after the supported touchdown.

reward_terms.name: placed
reward_terms.formula: Terminal bonus for the continuous ordered skill, throughout the last half second inside the exact stability and rest bounds.

reward_terms.name: reference_object
reward_terms.formula: Signed progress of symmetric reconstructed object keypoint error with 40 mm deadband, weighted at full strength while held or released in the goal.

reward_terms.name: reference_wrist
reward_terms.formula: Signed improvement in reachable reconstructed wrist position and orientation, with 100 mm and 45 degree deadbands.

reward_terms.name: reference_fingers
reward_terms.formula: Signed improvement in the median retargeted absolute posture error beyond 0.44 rad.

reward_terms.name: slip
reward_terms.formula: One loss penalty for a clear non-supported grip that loses contact before reaching the supported set-down.

reward_terms.name: action_rate
reward_terms.formula: Squared normalized changes of palm and finger targets, multiplied by five after a supported stable release.

reward_terms.name: failure
reward_terms.formula: Stop, hardware or observation-contract failure, nonfinite state or an object dropped beyond the table.

reward_terms.name: enclosed
reward_terms.formula: One bonus for at least 0.10 s of grounded thumb and opposing-digit contact at 60 degrees or more within 10 mm of pickup.

reward_terms.name: push
reward_terms.formula: Positive outward planar displacement over 3 mm before pickup plus a small absolute sliding penalty beyond that radius. No refund on return.

reward_terms.name: safety
reward_terms.formula: Squared normalized torque margin beyond 12 N·m and near-limit finger margin. Only penalties from physical state.

reward_terms.name: grounded_tilt
reward_terms.formula: Increasing departure from the initial blade tilt beyond 15 degrees while the plug is still supported before a qualifying lift.

reward_terms.name: release_progress
reward_terms.formula: Signed change in untouched support after a valid touchdown, with the upright object inside the goal and below both motion limits.

reward_terms.name: rest_progress
reward_terms.formula: Signed change in a half-second placed-and-released rest potential, based on measured palm and encoder ranges.

body.text: The contact-aware critic gives better pre-update value fit, longer opposed holds and fewer early hardware excursions than the control. Neither learns a qualifying turn. Its safe endpoint has 52/64 lifts, while the pending r0230 gate candidate has 60 and perfect lift on the separate 128 development sheet. Keep the critic as a training option without promoting either actor. Raising the closest-turn control midpoint start another 4, 6 or 8 mm leaves 12, 19 and seven hardware failures on 36 targeted prefixes. No variant enters full evaluation.

Measure whether the turn is undersampled in the PPO actor objective. In the matched critic experiments a 1,152-step batch typically contains only about 24–31 verified airborne opposed-turn rows. A training-only variant gives those rows six times the actor surrogate weight, renormalized by the batch mean. The critic objective, action distribution, applied KL bound, reward and PPO curriculum stay fixed. Four smoke updates processed 115 held rows and stayed below 0.03967 applied KL. Preserve exact stochastic full-start safe-turn traces as diagnostic evidence, excluding their actions from all later PPO batches. Choose the training parent and budget after the pending pickup gate and any new target replay.

body.hypothesis: Paired startup screening during end-to-end PPO improves pickup reliability. A fixed 4 mm higher ramp endpoint reduces the loaded middle MCP2 excursion found in targeted repeats. Together they should raise stage lift without introducing a safety or later-stage regression.
body.observed: In the r0128 failure montages, seeds 1837810337 and 302245090 have the plug pinched in the air at 2.50 s and grounded beside the opening hand by 5.22 s. The grip does not survive into an upright turn. This change tests reliable acquisition of that opposed grip as a prerequisite for the missing continuation.
body.success_rule: every stage, at rest over the last 0.5 s (finger joint range <= 0.05 rad, palm range <= 0.005 m), hardware within limits, no stop
body.reason: 'lift' better on the same seeds: 12 episodes only the candidate completes vs 0 only the incumbent (sign test p = 0.00024 <= 0.05); no stage significantly worse; hardware violations 0 vs 0

body.text: r0238 accepts r0230 in exact v6 at 62/64 lifts versus 50/64 for r0128, 12 new-only and zero incumbent-only, no later stages, no hardware events or stops, and 64 rests. Gate contract check p99 0.556 ms and 38,400 replay actions p99 0.836 ms. Submitted package 2f39b21ce070… as s05 for [redacted]. In the reviewed montages, seed 903955589 holds through 7.90 s and leaves the plug on the table by 10.58 s. Opposed time 9.09 s, standard relative and world rotations 46.7° and 59.4°, passive 27.3°, final y −0.332 m, sideways. Seed 426086772 holds at 2.50 s and loses it by 5.22 s. Opposed time 3.02 s, relative 33.6°, world 24.6°, no passive, final y −0.391 m, sideways. Next work targets active finger rotation during the held interval. Offline r0230 exact preflight traces provide 640 robust lifted contexts across 128 starts and 80 partly turned ones across 17, retaining live observation and controller history if used in a later curriculum.

The conditional pickup-noise endpoint checkpoint 0527 is the first learned package with deterministic qualifying turns, 4/64 on the fixed sheet. All four finish 600 calls and rest without stop, violation or contract issue. Three finish upright at y −0.297 to −0.311 m outside the goal. No carry qualifies. One separate start 368306896 stops its evaluation for 0.02848 rad measured middle MCP2 overrun at 0.39 s during thumb–middle pickup. Compare unchanged weights and +2/+4/+6 mm ramp variants on three known risky starts with eight sensor draws, 24 fresh pickup prefixes and three whole repeats of each of the four safe turn starts. Expect at least two retained original turns and zero safety events before a full independent comparison. Also replay the learned turn logs through the original and window-aligned reward to see whether either credited carry after the true turn. Target s05 is still pending.

body.simulation: Full assembled 2 ms CPU MuJoCo with continuous arm impedance, sampled 100 Hz state, bit-exact visibility kernel and CUDA optimizer. Training uses the compiled station DLS IK. Open-loop compensation tests match all criteria for three complete witnesses and 64 learned traces. Task evaluation uses the frozen NumPy implementation.
body.actor_observations: Only v3 keys. Eight fixed history taps at 0, 1, 2, 5, 10, 20, 40 and 63 calls ago. No clock or private state. Causal latest-target minus measured position and hand-encoder errors provide contact-related observability.
body.critic_observations: Actor history and training-only physical phase, true object center and blade, palm/object offset, velocities, contact and support, and mechanics draws.
body.algorithm: PPO from scratch with diagonal Gaussian exploration, episode-persistent independent Gaussian bias of 0.12 raw units, clipped likelihood and value, normalized GAE and KL guard 0.055. Advantages are normalized separately by reset mode if group_advantage is set. This segment resumes the single random-initialized PPO actor from the recorded parent checkpoint. This segment initializes the critic and optimizer afresh. The applied actor change is backtracked in parameter space until the analytic Gaussian KL from the rollout policy meets the configured bound. The optimizer moments and critic updates are retained. Each block of PPO updates is tested on paired deterministic physics prefixes against the initial actor. A candidate may lose at most the configured number of lifts and must match or improve the count of safe trials. Rejection restores actor, critic and Adam and reduces the learning rate. These episodes only constrain update acceptance. On deployment resets, scale Gaussian exploration and episode bias by 0.33 before the first qualifying lift. Use the actual conditional scale for PPO likelihood and KL. The exported actor is deterministic.
body.actions: The actor commands 26 dimensions using bounded offsets from the measured palm and joint positions. The fixed work-volume and 0.68 rad wrist posture bound precede causal smoothing. Target deltas are bounded by 9 mm, 0.022 rad rotation and 0.066 rad per finger per call. Finger offset radius is 0.45 rad with a 0.037 rad target margin. This run uses the bounded action transform frozen in the selected startup-safety package. Its precise source path is in the hyperparameters.
body.hypothesis: Reduce stochastic pickup noise to supply more reliable opposed grips for PPO.
body.reflection: The 17-minute evaluation gives 56/64 lifts, 64 rests and no safety or contract events, with no exact turn. Median clear opposition is 3.135 s. The closest eligible blade tilt is 44.70 deg with up to 47.09 deg relative rotation. Continue to the endpoint because the lift threshold is met.

body.text: The four learned exact turns first reach all local angular checks on the last opposed row, at 2.21, 2.44, 2.99 and 3.19 s. Whole-interval passive is zero in all four. The original first-anchor reward pays turn and enters carry in two of four. The already tested continuous-window variant recognizes all four, lifting return on the two missed cases from 1.52 to 9.51 and 3.08 to 10.94. Neither gives more than 0.113 total carry progress. Use this evidence to focus the next continuation on preserving grip after the real turn and entering transport. The directed-reward endpoint holds longer but misses the tilt threshold. No target [redacted] response yet.

At the four learned turns, correct orientation arrives at the final opposed sample and carry progress never exceeds 0.113. The window-aligned bonus corrects the missed transition in two of four. Preflight a training-only refinement that pays 40% of the turn bonus at exact qualification, then pays the balance only after 0.20 s of uninterrupted airborne hand contact, tilt at most 35 degrees and 10 mm real progress toward the goal. Assisted reset rewards and the frozen verification stay fixed. Compare still, random, three full feasibility witnesses and the four learned turns. Require all complete witnesses to retain the full bonus and the learned drops to retain only partial credit before considering a PPO run.

Reduced-noise checkpoint 0527 validates its turn gain on the independent 128: 13 qualifying turns, 12 ending upright beside pickup, 111 lifts, zero carries and four hardware excursions. All three small ramp corrections still have selected risk failures. The +4 mm arm pose preserves 10/12 repeated turns versus 8/12 nominal and cuts targeted hardware failures from 10/24 to 3/24, with 22/24 fresh lifts. Use it as a development parent only. Measure its full fixed and independent outcomes and collect risky physical starts from a separate 512-prefix training slate. The new turn-continuation reward passes preflight: all three complete witnesses retain 5.0 turn credit, all four learned drops retain 2.0, static is zero and random negative. This gives a measurable training hypothesis about preserving grip into carry.

body.observation_mismatch: All eight replays start from the first valid target pose and the s05 arm and hand ramp. They use every sent command. Six trials have 600 valid target poses. The two target misses have 433 and 467 valid rows, with 600 replay estimates each. Target median pose age is 43.33 ms and p95 is 53.33 ms. Replay median age is 43.52–73.06 ms and matched valid estimate center RMSE is 3.19–26.30 mm. Separate sensor draws change those residuals. The locked commands isolate the physical outcome from replay sensor age.
body.dynamics_mismatch: Replay qualifies all eight lifts. The target misses pickup on trials 0 and 4. The corresponding simulated peak bottom clearances are 13.21 and 18.39 mm versus 2.78 and 2.33 mm in the target estimates. Trial 1 reproduces a long sideways hold, with replay opposed duration 12.90 s and target estimated geometric lift for 12.73 s. Target trial 6 is within 25 degrees of upright by 1.40 s with 10.95 mm estimated bottom clearance and ends upright outside the goal. Replay reaches minimum tilt 69.94 degrees and ends sideways. All replays complete 600 calls, rest and pass hardware. Palm RMS is 0.785–1.283 mm. Pooled finger RMSE is 0.02745 rad through 0.30 s, 0.09559 rad through 4.4 s and 0.09637 rad afterward. Replay torque peaks are 4.28–4.63 Nm at 0.13 s compared with target peak range 2.26–2.79 Nm.
body.changes: Retain recorded v6 parameters after outcome comparison. In 112 fixed-parameter runs, low grip, short delay, higher bandwidth and lower hand friction each improve lift agreement from 6/8 to 7/8 while all variants miss the upright support face of trial 6. A 45 ms delay lowers median replay torque to 2.82 Nm, with unchanged lift agreement. Across two matched 96-run groups, wider hand and support friction, filter and delay draws preserve 74 pickup matches and 84 support matches in each group. Median object error changes from 11.07 to 11.86 mm. Separate start shifts up to 1.5 mm and 1.5 degrees retain all 16 replay lifts on each target miss and give zero upright finishes on trial 6. Treat this residual contact sensitivity as a transfer limitation. The next PPO comparison preserves v6 and tests safe pickup coverage and continuous transport after the window-aligned turn.

body.text: After r0249 and r0250, keep exact v6 and continue the r0248 actor in three matched 36-minute PPO experiments. The control uses the corrected opposed turn window. The transport variant defers three of five turn bonus points until the existing grip makes 10 mm toward the goal after 0.20 s. A separate risk-reset variant keeps the control reward and samples 20% of deployment reset seeds from 32 independently measured small-margin training starts, with fresh sensing. Each uses 16 stations, seed 773421, fixed 20 s episodes and the same original physical reset mix, actor, new Adam and critic, raw std 0.12 with 0.33 pickup factor, applied KL 0.040, and paired eight-block lift screening. Preserve optimization state for later continuation. Existing r0071 station checks, r0007 reference and compiled reachability remain valid, with per-row monitor and finite-state termination. Check fixed64 at about 8, 18 and 36 minutes. Stop a branch after 18 if it has fewer than 32 safe lifts, zero safe turns, and no held-turn geometry or transport gain. A new deployable candidate must confirm turns and no safety regression on independent starts before the gate. This study uses the actual trigger shown by r0245 and r0248, where turns consistently arrive at grip loss.
